column1: | S483 | vLLM preload health route @ v0.31.0 — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vllm-project/vllm/v0.31.0/vllm/entrypoints/cli/preload.py | code | A | which process answers the `/health` route that v0.31.0 ships and the HTTP states it can return — one file at one tag; not the inference server's `/health` (S004), not the pull request's description of the change (S481), and not runtime behaviour or a later tag | §`_build_health_app` lines 70-77: route registration line 73 `@app.get("/health", include_in_schema=False)` and handler line 75 `return Response(status_code=200 if state.is_ready else 503)` §`_HealthState.is_ready` lines 63-67, line 67 `return ready and not any(proc.exitcode is not None for proc in self.processes)` §startup gate line 302 `health_state.mark_ready()`, reached only if no rank exited during startup (the exit path at lines 288-301 ends in `sys.exit`) §opt-in flag lines 133-138, help line 137 "Port for the parent /health endpoint; disabled by default." §tag v0.31.0; raw SHA-256 d2704e80c08f49455c048724dce8d1eeb22bfa9bc97961ef567106425effa57d, 12631 bytes, re-fetched 2026-10-26 (copy .ufo/waves/round-44/w1/out/S9D2Row/vllm-v0.31.0-preload.py), byte-identical to the committed copy .ufo/waves/round-43/c3/vllm-v0.31.0-preload.py and to the blob at merge commit e7900156e130c9880eb03b7c1f2df32820e7a2be (git blob sha1 50734a052bb01b613a831f982c3ad0449951a123) | the `/health` route in v0.31.0 is served by the preload CLI's own health app for the weight-cache daemon parent, not by the inference server; it returns exactly two HTTP outcomes — 200 only while `is_ready` holds (every daemon process alive and `mark_ready` already called after startup) and 503 otherwise, so `starting` and `failed` are indistinguishable on the wire — and no listener exists unless `--weight-cache-health-port` is set | mined | 2026-10-26 | on-release | corpus/knowledge/runtime-health-surface-processes.md |
